allow: PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match "probe-tiff" -or $_.MainWindowTitle -match "probe-tiff" } | Stop-Process -Force; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table Id, ProcessName, StartTime -Auto)

Bash(node -e "const gdal = require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('GDAL version:', gdal.version\); const ds = gdal.open\('D:/TIFF/clutter-india-25m.tif'\); console.log\('opened:', ds.rasterSize.x, 'x', ds.rasterSize.y, 'bands=' + ds.bands.count\(\), 'srs=' + \(ds.srs ? ds.srs.getAuthorityCode\(\) : 'none'\)\); ds.close\(\);")

Bash(ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron -e "try { const gdal = require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('LOADED via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE, GDAL version:', gdal.version\); const ds = gdal.open\('D:/TIFF/clutter-india-25m.tif'\); console.log\('opened:', ds.rasterSize.x, 'x', ds.rasterSize.y, 'bands=' + ds.bands.count\(\), 'srs=' + ds.srs.getAuthorityCode\(\)\); ds.close\(\); console.log\('OK'\); } catch\(e\) { console.error\('FAILED:', e.message\); process.exit\(1\); }")

Bash(ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron -e "console.log\(JSON.stringify\({node: process.versions.node, electron: process.versions.electron, modules: process.versions.modules, env: process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE}, null, 2\)\)")

Bash(node -e "const g=require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('GDAL', g.version\); const drivers=[]; for \(let i=0;i<g.drivers.count\(\);i++\){drivers.push\(g.drivers.get\(i\).description\);} console.log\('WEBP available:', drivers.includes\('WEBP'\)\); console.log\('All drivers:', drivers.filter\(d => d.match\(/PNG|WEBP|JPEG/i\)\).join\(', '\)\);")
Bash(node -e "const g=require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('reprojectImageAsync:', typeof g.reprojectImageAsync\); const ds=g.open\('test'\); console.log\('placeholder'\);")
Bash(node -e "const g=require\('gdal-async'\); const d=g.drivers.get\('MEM'\); console.log\('createAsync:', typeof d.createAsync\); console.log\('createCopyAsync:', typeof d.createCopyAsync\);")

Bash(node -e "const g=require\('gdal-async'\); const d=g.drivers.get\('MEM'\); const ds=d.create\('',1,1,1\); console.log\('closeAsync:', typeof ds.closeAsync\); console.log\('vsimem.releaseAsync:', typeof g.vsimem.releaseAsync\);")

Bash(node -e "const g=require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('warp:', typeof g.warp\); console.log\('warpAsync:', typeof g.warpAsync\); console.log\('translate:', typeof g.translate\); console.log\('translateAsync:', typeof g.translateAsync\); console.log\('suggestedWarpOutput:', typeof g.suggestedWarpOutput\);")
